_comment: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY used to sit here as placeholders,
waiting to be filled in with real values. This repository is PUBLIC, so filling them in would
have committed them forever. EAS holds them instead — it is also the only place a cloud build
If they are ever missing, mobile/lib/supabase.ts throws by name on first launch rather than
failing quietly. The Apple values below stay as placeholders on purpose: the pre-flight
(npm run check-eas) refuses to submit while they are, and a public repo is no place for an
Apple ID — pass them to `eas submit` as flags if you would rather not commit them at all.
